package: LGA-16 optical module + thermal pad, 6.4 x 3.0 mm
height_note: 1.500 +-0.050 (outline p24); liner on the cap during reflow, removed before the cover window is fitted (p29)

footprint_drawing.pads: A1-A7, C1-C7 on two long rows, B1/B7 at the ends, B4 = thermal pad (must go to ground plane, p6)
footprint_drawing.optics: Rx aperture centre 1.250 from the right end (fig 21); emitter on the opposite side; mechanical-to-optical centre offset 0.100
footprint_drawing.todo: pad sizes and pitch are on fig 22 (p25) and were not transcribed; KiCad has ST_VL53L1x and ST_VL53L0X only: draw a new footprint

circuit.role: I2C pull-ups (fig 5 shows 2.2k; on the shared I2C_S bus there is one pair for the whole bus, not one per part)

supplies.AVDD: 2.8 or 3.3 V (3.0-3.6 V in the 3.3 V configuration)
supplies.I_ranging_mA: AVDD 45 typ / 50 max + IOVDD 50 typ / 80 max (about 95 mA total); peaks +10 mA on each
supplies.sequencing: IOVDD on at the same time as or after AVDD, off before or with AVDD; avoid IOVDD powered with AVDD off (p9). One rail for both satisfies this.

logic: IOVDD = 3.3 V: SCL/SDA/LPn/INT/I2C_RST abs max 3.6 V (p15); I2C pads use 1.8 V thresholds at every IOVDD (VIH 1.13 V, p17), so 3.3 V I2C_S works directly. All digital inputs must be driven to IOVDD level (p6).

i2c_addr.select: no address pin. The address is changed in RAM by the ULD driver after every power-up [mem: vl53l5cx_set_i2c_address, UM2884]. Same default as the VL53L1X: hold the VL53L1X in XSHUT (low) while the VL53L5CX boots and is moved, then release XSHUT. LPn exists to do the same between several VL53L5CX (p6).

expander: TOF2_LPN (output; also selects the low-power idle with I2C off)
TOF2_INT (input, optional: data ready / autonomous threshold)
TOF_PWR_EN (shared rail switch with the VL53L1X)

placement: Top side under the same infrared-transmissive (940 nm) window strip as the VL53L1X but with its own aperture: the window opening must be at least the collector exclusion cone, 55.5 x 61 deg (82 deg diagonal), wider than the 45 x 45 deg (63 deg diagonal) detection volume (p3 table 2).
Cover-glass crosstalk is handled by the histogram processing beyond 60 cm (p2); closer than that a cover needs crosstalk calibration (AN5657 [not read]).
Thermal pad soldered to a ground plane with vias: up to about 0.3 W while ranging (p16 table 13).
Keep the emitter away from the colour/brightness window (AS7341, OPT4001): wall or separate window.
Class 1 laser: no lens or optics that concentrate the beam (p27).
notes: Firmware: the ULD driver uploads about 84 KB of firmware over I2C at every power-up [mem]; at the 400 kHz limit set by other parts on I2C_S (MMC5983MA) that takes a few seconds.
Rather than a rail switch, the 45 uA LP idle (I2C off via LPn) could be used; the rail switch is worth it because LP idle can reach 300 uA (p16).
If the rail is switched while I2C_S stays live, the unpowered module's I2C pins must not load the bus: not stated in the data sheet (see REPORT, switched-rail parts).
